capabilities: Indent content, lists, code blocks, tables, and callouts by heading level
Draw a vertical guide line for each heading level
Increase heading size and weight differences across H1–H6
Adjust indent distance per level and hide guide lines in settings
Disable indentation per note via frontmatter
disambiguation: Not an outliner; it only changes how existing headings and their content are displayed, not how notes are structured.
extras: Settings page is localized in 10 languages; README includes a Chinese-language section; the author warns against editing the plugin's styles.css directly because updates overwrite it.
intentEvidence: Clearer headings: larger size and weight differences between H1–H6, and an underline under H1.
problem: Obsidian renders nested content flush with the margin, so the level structure of long notes and the difference between heading levels are hard to see at a glance.

relations.evidence: If you also use Heading Level Indent, turn it off so content is not indented twice.

summary: Heading-level indenter that indents content under each heading, draws vertical guide lines per level, and makes heading sizes easier to tell apart.
